jobs.title: Sr, Engineer - Space Mission
jobs.description:
Below is the description of the need. As you will find, this is a broad role supporting a variety of things like: Mission Operations, Launch, Payload, GPS etc.
 
We are looking to backfill this position within 30 days if possible, with a level 3 engineer, the position will be hybrid (expecting at least 2 days per week in the El Segundo office) with some travel required. Please see below for job duties and qualifications. If you have any questions, please let me know.
  
Key Responsibilities

Mission Planning and Transition Execution




Contribute to planning, coordinating, and documenting SV transitions from production to launch, on-orbit checkout, operations, sustainment, and disposable.
Evaluate progress against the Government-approved transition plan to identify and report potential risks or issues.
Suggest and implement improvements when deviations occur, including collaborating with stakeholders to develop corrective action plans and re-plan transitions with Government approval.




Launch, On-Orbit Checkout, and System Integration Support




Analyze satellite vendor-provided ground support equipment, launch, operational, and test procedures to detect deficiencies.
Collaborate with Space Segment and Control Segment prime contractors, as well as PNT enterprise stakeholders, to ensure identified issues are resolved and reported at Government transition meetings.




Team Training and Support for Mission Operations




Develop comprehensive training materials, lesson plans, and schedules to prepare GPS IIIF Mission Directors and Launch Management Teams (LMT).
Provide classroom instruction, operational floor training, and support for directing launch and early orbit efforts, on-orbit checkout, and extended stages of Launch and Checkout Capability (LCC) operations.
Ensure the Mission Operations team is ready to support key milestones such as Integrated System Testing and Satellite Control Authority transfer to 2 NWS.




Technical Documentation Development




Assist in creating technical documentation to facilitate the operational transition of GPS IIIF SVs into the Main Control Segment (MCS), including but not limited to:








Operational Concepts Documents (OPSCONs)
Communication Plans
Freeze Charters
Memorandums of Agreement (MOAs)





Qualifications
Required:

Bachelor’s degree in engineering related technical field.
5+ years of experience in satellite operations, mission planning, launch operations, or systems engineering.
Familiarity with GPS program requirements, Space Vehicle development, Launch and Checkout Capability (LCC), and Control Segment systems.
Proven ability to collaborate with multiple stakeholders and align complex requirements, schedules, and actions to meet project deadlines.
Strong analytical skills to monitor and evaluate project performance against schedules and objectives.
Proficiency in technical writing, including the preparation of operational documents and presentations for multi-stakeholder environments.
Active Secret Security clearance

Preferred:

Master’s degree in a related discipline or advanced certifications in mission operations or systems engineering.
Experience with space vehicle operations, particularly in transition planning, launch management, and system integration.
Broad knowledge of satellite operational concepts, GPS constellation management, and aerospace systems.

jobs.title: Executive Assistant
jobs.description:
Condé Nast is seeking an Executive Assistant to provide proactive, reliable support for one of its executives. The Executive Assistant will ensure efficient operation of the executive’s office. Duties may be clerical, administrative and project-based, including: scheduling travel, arranging meetings, planning events, handling information requests, preparing reports and correspondence, and liaising with senior contacts, executive leadership team members, and external partners.

This role represents the executive’s office and requires a partner who can juggle the multiple demands on the executive’s time with ease and grace. The ideal candidate is someone who is highly detail oriented, can balance a high number of internal & external meeting requests and prioritize appropriately. The role needs a self-motivated individual who will proactively anticipate, identify, and meet the needs of the executive.
The Executive Assistant is responsible for confidential and time sensitive material, and as such, requires urgency, efficiency, sensitivity, diplomacy and discretion.
The ideal candidate will have the ability to effectively and professionally communicate via phone, text, slack, and email to ensure that all duties are completed accurately and delivered with high quality, in a timely manner.

Primary Responsibilities:

Proactive calendar management and prioritization: Providing real-time scheduling support by booking appointments and preventing conflicts
Ensuring the executive has all relevant preparation and materials that will be reviewed and discussed in meetings
Gathering inputs from appropriate stakeholders and preparing materials for the executive’s leadership meetings, 1:1 meetings, etc.
Organizing meetings, offsites, activities and team all hands — scheduling, contacting participants, securing location/meeting rooms/venue, catering and tech set-up, owning agendas, preparing documentation for distribution/presenting, capturing actionable next steps, circulating follow-up materials, etc.
Coordinating meeting logistics with internal & external guests — registration with building security if applicable, sharing details around arrival information, greeting and assisting visitors
Making domestic and international travel arrangements, such as booking flights, cars, making hotel and restaurant reservations. Ensuring seamless travel experience for the executive, creating clear and purposeful itineraries/preparation materials
Anticipating the needs of others in order to ensure their seamless and positive experience
Working with a global team across different time zones
Processing business expenses in a timely manner
Handling office tasks, such as generating reports and presentations, setting up for meetings, and reordering supplies

 Skills & Qualifications:

5+ years of administrative experience
Experience supporting C-Level Executives
College degree required
Excellent organizational skills and a master multi-tasker
Self-driven, motivated, and solutions-oriented with an ability to “think on your feet” and demonstrate personal accountability, initiative, and follow-through
Intellectual curiosity and desire to learn the business to facilitate thoughtful team support.
Experience with managing international travel and calendars required
Proficiency with Google suite products (Gmail, Docs, Sheets, etc.) and ability to quickly learn internal systems.
Candidate must demonstrate emotional intelligence, judgment, discretion, and confidentiality in all matters
Strong writing and verbal communication skills

jobs.title: Logistics Supervisor
jobs.description:
Job Description:
The Logistics Supervisor oversees daily logistics operations for inbound, outbound, international, and domestic shipments, as well as 3PL order management. This role ensures shipments are executed on time, cost-effectively, and in compliance with customs and transportation requirements. The Logistics Supervisor works closely with internal teams, carriers, freight forwarders, vendors, suppliers, and customs platforms to resolve issues, maintain accurate documentation, and improve logistics processes.
 
Job Responsibilities:

Supervise and coordinate daily logistics activities, including shipment planning, scheduling, tracking, and delivery follow-up.
Oversee inbound, outbound, international, and domestic shipments to ensure timely and accurate execution.
Coordinate with carriers, freight forwarders, vendors, and suppliers to confirm pickups, routing, delivery appointments, and shipment status.
Monitor shipment exceptions, including delays, damages, missing information, or carrier issues, and ensure timely resolution.
Manage carrier claims for damaged, lost, or missing cargo, including documentation and follow-up through resolution.
Prepare, review, and maintain shipping documentation, including labels, customs paperwork, invoices, delivery receipts, and compliance records.
Manage VUCE permits, ITBIS exemptions, tax payment requests, and other import/export documentation requirements.
Ensure import/export compliance, including accurate HTS codes, duties, taxes, and supporting documentation.
Support creation of PO s, Sales Orders, Transfer Orders for our Global facilities.
Support SKU creation, SKU upload and PO reconciliation.
Support onboarding and coordination of international suppliers and logistics partners.
Maintain strong relationships with carriers, freight forwarders, vendors, and internal stakeholders.
Identify opportunities to reduce freight costs, improve delivery performance, consolidate shipments, and streamline logistics processes.
Provide guidance and support to logistics team members and serve as an escalation point for shipment-related issues.
Track logistics performance and provide updates or reports to leadership as needed.

 
Who You Are:

5+ years of experience in logistics, supply chain, transportation, freight forwarding, or import/export operations.
Minimum of 2 years of supervisory experience, including leading, training, coaching, or coordinating the work of others.
Fluent in both English and Spanish, with the ability to communicate clearly with internal teams, vendors, suppliers, and international partners.
Strong understanding of import/export procedures, customs documentation, HTS codes, duties, taxes, and compliance requirements.
Comfortable using ERP systems, logistics platforms, customs systems, shipment tracking tools, and Microsoft Office Suite, especially Excel, Word, and Outlook.
Able to review documentation carefully, identify issues quickly, and follow through on exceptions until resolved.
Professional and proactive when coordinating with carriers, vendors, freight forwarders, customs partners, internal teams, and leadership.
Able to identify cost-saving opportunities, improve workflows, and support reliable, efficient logistics operations.

jobs.title: Data Analyst
jobs.description:
The Client is a leading manufacturer and distributor of storage solutions, serving multiple sales verticals including commercial, industrial, retail, and government sectors. We are seeking a highly analytical and technically skilled Data Analyst to join our Miami team. This role is central to how we understand our business — from tracking sales revenue performance across all verticals to analyzing manufacturing costs, pricing models, and operational data flows.
The ideal candidate is an experienced report and dashboard builder who is equally comfortable pulling raw data from complex systems as they are presenting clean, actionable insights to leadership. You will work closely with Sales, Manufacturing, Finance, and Operations to deliver the data intelligence that drives strategic decisions at the client. 

 
KEY RESPONSIBILITIES
Sales Revenue & Multi-Vertical Analytics
•     Build and maintain comprehensive sales performance dashboards tracking revenue across all Quantum Storage Systems sales verticals — commercial, industrial, retail, and government
•     Analyze sales trends, pipeline data, win/loss rates, and revenue forecasting across each vertical and sales team
•     Develop margin and profitability reports by product line, customer segment, region, and sales channel
•     Support sales leadership with territory performance analysis, quota attainment tracking, and comparative period reporting
•     Identify revenue trends, outliers, and growth opportunities through ongoing analysis of multi-vertical sales data
Manufacturing, Pricing & Costing Analytics
•     Analyze manufacturing cost data including raw materials, labor, overhead, and production efficiency metrics
•     Build and maintain pricing and costing models that reflect current input costs, margins, and market positioning
•     Track cost variances, production yield rates, and bill-of-materials changes to support accurate product pricing
•     Develop reports that provide Finance and Operations with real-time visibility into cost-of-goods-sold (COGS) and gross margin by product and vertical
•     Partner with the manufacturing team to monitor production KPIs, capacity utilization, and throughput analytics
•     Support product pricing reviews with data-driven analysis of material costs, competitive positioning, and margin targets
System Data Mapping & Data Management
•     Own and maintain data mapping documentation across Quantum Storage Systems' core platforms — including NetSuite, Suite Analytics, and Power BI
•     Build and maintain data dictionaries, field mapping guides, and data flow diagrams that document how data moves between systems
•     Identify data integrity issues, inconsistencies, or gaps across systems and work with IT and system admins to resolve them
•     Partner with NetSuite administrators to ensure reporting fields, custom records, and workflows are structured for accurate data capture
•     Support system migrations, upgrades, and integrations by providing data validation, testing, and mapping support
Reporting, Dashboards & Business Intelligence
•     Design, build, and continuously improve Power BI dashboards and reports for Sales, Finance, Manufacturing, and Executive leadership
•     Develop and maintain Suite Analytics Workbooks and saved searches within NetSuite for operational and financial reporting
•     Create recurring reporting packages including weekly sales summaries, monthly financial close reports, and quarterly operational reviews
•     Automate manual reporting workflows using Python scripts, scheduled Power BI refreshes, and NetSuite automation
•     Translate complex datasets and business questions into clear, visually compelling reports accessible to non-technical stakeholders
•     Maintain a library of standardized report templates, dashboards, and data definitions for use across departments
 


Must-Have Qualifications


Bachelor’s degree in Data Analytics, Information Systems, Computer Science, Finance, or related field
3+ years of experience in a data analyst / business analyst / reporting analyst role
Strong hands-on experience with:
	
NetSuite (reporting / data extraction / financial data handling)
Power BI (dashboard creation, data visualisation, reporting)
Python (data manipulation, automation, analysis)


Advanced Excel skills (pivot tables, lookups, data analysis)
Experience working with large datasets and data cleansing
Ability to:
	
Analyse data and generate actionable insights
Translate business requirements into reporting solutions


Strong experience in data reporting, dashboarding, and performance tracking
Good communication skills with ability to interact with business stakeholders

Preferred Qualifications (Nice-to-Have)

Experience with SQL for data extraction and querying
Exposure to ERP systems beyond NetSuite (SAP, Oracle, etc.)
Experience building dashboards from scratch vs maintaining existing reports
Previous experience in [client’s industry – confirm with POC if needed]
Familiarity with data warehousing concepts or BI architecture
Experience with automation / scripting in Python for reporting workflows
Exposure to additional BI tools (Tableau, Looker, etc.)
Experience working in a fast-paced, onsite operational environment
Strong understanding of business KPIs and performance metrics

jobs.title: Network engineer
jobs.description:
As a Network Engineer, you will support the implementation and maintenance of network infrastructure under the guidance of more experienced engineers. You’ll assist with troubleshooting, configuration, and monitoring tasks while developing a strong understanding of networking fundamentals. Your role will focus on hands-on learning, contributing to documentation, and participating in on-call rotations with senior oversight. Over time, you’ll build expertise in networking technologies, automation tools, and troubleshooting methodologies, setting the stage for growth into a more independent engineering role.


Responsibilities:

Assist in analyzing, designing, configuring, and maintaining network infrastructure under supervision.
Support senior engineers in troubleshooting and issue resolution.
Learn and provide basic recommendations for networking improvements.
Assist in responding to emergent events under guidance.
Act as the first point of contact for emergent network issues before escalation.
Support delivery of critical projects by executing defined tasks.
Coordinate with third-party vendors for troubleshooting and maintenance tasks.
Contribute to internal RFCs by reviewing and providing minor updates.
Use existing automation tools and processes to monitor network health and respond to alerts.
Participate in On-Call rotation with senior support.


Required Qualifications:

Basic understanding of networking concepts and hands-on experience with routing and switching fundamentals (e.g., IP, BGP, OSPF, LACP, STP).
Exposure to network security tools such as firewalls, VPNs, and load balancers.
Familiarity with network utilities like ICMP, Syslog, and Wireshark.
Basic understanding of wireless networking and remote access solutions.


Desired Qualifications:

Exposure to Palo Alto, Aruba, Juniper, or Arista technologies.
Basic scripting knowledge (e.g., Python) for automation.
Experience with network monitoring tools.
Understanding of AWS networking concepts.
Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or related field (or equivalent experience).

jobs.title: Jr Automation Engineer/Systems Engineer
jobs.description:
job description
Location: Onsite at Pharmaceutical Manufacturing Facility
Employment Type: Full-Time
Reports To: Lead Automation Engineer / Project Manager
Position Summary
We are seeking a motivated Junior Automation Engineer to join our system integration team supporting a major pharmaceutical manufacturing client. This role provides hands-on experience working with industrial automation systems used in GMP-regulated manufacturing environments. The Junior Automation Engineer will assist with the design, programming, testing, commissioning, and support of automation and control systems while working closely with senior engineers, operators, maintenance personnel, and client stakeholders.
This is an excellent opportunity for an early-career engineer interested in industrial automation, pharmaceutical manufacturing, process control, and digital transformation technologies.
Key Responsibilities

Assist in the development, configuration, and troubleshooting of PLC, HMI, and SCADA systems.
Support automation projects throughout the full project lifecycle, including design, implementation, testing, startup, and commissioning.
Participate in Factory Acceptance Testing (FAT), Site Acceptance Testing (SAT), and validation activities.
Assist with automation system upgrades, migrations, and continuous improvement initiatives.
Develop and maintain technical documentation, including:

Functional Design Specifications (FDS)
Software Design Specifications (SDS)
Test protocols
Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs)
As-built documentation


Perform field verification, I/O checks, loop checks, and startup support.
Troubleshoot automation, instrumentation, and process control issues in manufacturing environments.
Collaborate with cross-functional teams including Manufacturing, Quality, Validation, Maintenance, and Engineering.
Follow GMP, FDA, and company compliance requirements while working in regulated pharmaceutical environments.
Participate in on-call support or occasional off-shift activities during system startups and project cutovers.
Maintain a strong commitment to safety and quality standards.

Required Qualifications

Bachelor's degree in:

Electrical Engineering
Computer Engineering
Automation Engineering
Engineering Technology
Mechatronics 
Or related technical discipline


0-3 years of experience in industrial automation, controls engineering, manufacturing engineering, or related field.
Basic understanding of industrial control systems and automation concepts.
Familiarity with PLC programming and HMI development.
Strong problem-solving and analytical skills.
Excellent written and verbal communication skills.
Ability to work effectively in a team-oriented client-facing environment.
Willingness to work onsite at a pharmaceutical manufacturing facility.

Internship, co-op, or project experience involving industrial automation.

Technical Skills

PLC Programming (Allen-Bradley, Siemens)
HMI Development
SCADA Systems
Industrial Networking
Process Control
Instrumentation
Electrical Drawings and P&IDs
SQL Databases
Microsoft Office Suite
Technical Documentation

Direct exposure to large-scale pharmaceutical manufacturing operations.
Mentorship from experienced automation and controls engineers.
Experience working on GMP-regulated projects.
Opportunities to learn industry-leading automation platforms.
Career development path toward Automation Engineer, Controls Engineer, or Lead Automation Engineer roles.

Our engineers partner with some of the world's largest pharmaceutical and life sciences organizations to design, implement, and support mission-critical manufacturing systems that improve quality, reliability, and operational performance.

Purpose
The Maintenance Manager is responsible for leading plant maintenance and reliability excellence across highly automated, advanced manufacturing operations. This role is responsible for equipment uptime, asset reliability, and maintenance performance while leading a multidisciplinary technical team supporting high-pressure die casting, automation, machining, and digital manufacturing systems. The Maintenance Manager will drive world-class reliability practices, safety, continuous improvement, and integration of new technologies.

Key Accountabilities
1. Maintenance & Reliability Leadership
Lead, coach, and develop a multidisciplinary maintenance organization (electrical, mechanical, controls, robotics).

Establish and sustain world-class reliability systems including TPM, RCM, and predictive maintenance.

Own plant uptime and maintenance performance metrics; develop and execute strategies to reduce unplanned downtime.

Drive a culture of accountability, technical excellence, and continuous improvement across the maintenance team.

KPIs:
• Equipment uptime
• OEE
• MTBF / MTTR
• Planned vs. unplanned maintenance ratio
2. Advanced Automation & Equipment
Oversee maintenance, reliability, and performance of advanced manufacturing systems, including:

• HPDC mega-casting machines (high-tonnage clamping systems)
• Fully automated robotic casting cells
• Automated CNC machining and finishing lines
• AGV / AMR material handling systems
• Vision systems and inline quality inspection technologies
• Passivation and chemical surface treatment lines

Ensure equipment availability, technical capability, and safe operation across all systems.
3. Industry 4.0 & Predictive Maintenance
Implement and scale predictive maintenance technologies (vibration analysis, thermography, condition monitoring, AI-based diagnostics).

Support digital manufacturing and Smart Factory initiatives aligned with Nemak’s global strategy.

Leverage data analytics and CMMS/EAM systems to anticipate failures, optimize maintenance plans, and improve asset performance.

KPIs:
• Data-driven decision-making
• Failure prevention and proactive maintenance
4. Continuous Improvement & Operational Excellence
Lead structured problem-solving activities including RCA, FMEA, 8D, and Kaizen.

Drive Lean Manufacturing and Six Sigma initiatives within maintenance and reliability processes.

Partner with Production, Engineering, Quality, and IT to improve throughput, process capability, and overall equipment effectiveness.
5. Safety, Environmental & Regulatory Compliance
Ensure full compliance with OSHA, environmental, and chemical handling regulations.

Lead safe maintenance practices in high-temperature casting, automation, and chemical processing environments.

Champion a zero-incident safety culture through training, audits, and visible leadership.
6. Integration & Transformation Leadership
Support the integration of systems, standards, and teams into target operating model.

Align local practices with global standards and best practices.

Support ramp-up, stabilization, and commissioning of new equipment and emerging technologies.
7. Budget & Asset Management
Develop and manage maintenance budgets, including operating expense and CAPEX planning.

Optimize spare parts strategies and lifecycle management of critical assets.

Build and maintain strong OEM and supplier partnerships to ensure technical support and long-term equipment performance.
